human_contribution.scope: Requirements and authorization for bounded post-activation recovery; predecessor and governance preservation

artificial_cognitive_contribution.scope: Implementation, diagnostic tests and attributed verification

main_drift.scope: Node health/registration only; successor keeps #495 parent

test_harness_boundary: Local receipts used pause(1300) after late draft entry; final harness explicitly advances the context-wide cadence clock there. Native exact-head execution is separately required.
invariants: Existing immutable verified release caches reused
Existing strict IndexedDB checkpoints and data schema retained
No predecessor health inferred from byte completeness
All live clients required before promotion to healthy
Runtime failure or missing readiness quarantines failed release
Only complete previously health-confirmed cache used for recovery
In-flight peer token retained across failure broadcast
Existing checkpoint required before reload of an editing application
No version-loop, cache deletion, new update controller or protected-policy change
boundaries: First protocol bootstrap has no health-confirmed predecessor until a successful health cycle
No general detection of semantic errors or fully blocked JS thread
Suspended worker deadline is checked on next event; no guaranteed background execution
Browser-controlled storage can be externally evicted
No production acceptance, merge, Main activation or deployment

successor_repair.reason: Checkpoint every editable application before recovery, including the readiness-to-health-receipt interval; refuse reload of an editable legacy client without a checkpoint hook.
